description: Best tool when a buyer describes what they need in their own words. Combines semantic search (Voyage embeddings over supplier industry, HS codes, certifications, trade-fair history, and the EN summary) with structured filters (country, HS codes, certifications, employee range, year founded, business type, export markets). Returns a ranked list of supplier cards, each with a `matchExplanation` summarizing why it surfaced. Example brief: 'BSCI-certified Vietnam factory for women's woven outerwear, MOQ-flexible, 11-50 staff, exports to EU'.

brief.description: Freeform description of what the buyer is sourcing.

lang.description: Locale for the returned URLs. Default en.
